meta.name: b0_frozen_v1
meta.task: CN(0) vs MCI+Dem(1); 3-class multinomial fit on CN/MCI/Dem labels; score = 1 - P(CN)
meta.training_cohort: AI-Hub lifelog pooled 174 (CN 111 / MCI 51 / Dem 12), first 35 joined activity-sleep days

nested_headline.note: expected performance of the PROCEDURE (100 models on ~139 subjects); this artifact is ONE function fit on 174

definition.window: first 35 rows per subject of the activity⋈sleep inner-joined frame sorted by (sid, date); no wear gate; day gaps allowed
definition.join: activity date = activity_day_start (04:00 local, naive parse of first 19 chars); sleep date = sleep_bedtime_end date; sleep dedup (sid,date) keep longest sleep_duration; activity dedup (sid,date) keep-first (explicit key (sid,date,ts,activity_total desc) verified identical, CT9b); inner merge; subject must have >= 35 joined days
definition.low_SD: population SD (ddof=0) of daily activity_low minutes over the 35 window days; NaN if < 3 finite
definition.low_MED: median of daily activity_low minutes over the 35 window days

source_cells.cell2_join:
# ============================================================================
# 셀 2 — 라벨 계약 + MMSE fail-closed 가드 + activity ⋈ sleep 조인 (run-4 cell 2 와 동일) + 명시적 tie-break 동일성 (CT9b)
# ============================================================================
FORBIDDEN_PATTERN = re.compile(
    r"(?:^|_)mmse|^q\d+(?:_|$)|^total$|diag|doctor|sample_email|email"
    r"|non_?wear|(?:^|_)n_days|(?:^|_)span(?:$|_)"
    r"|(?:^|_)cover(?:age)?(?:$|_)|(?:^|_)gap_|missfrac|valid_days",
    re.IGNORECASE)
_MUST_PASS = ["low_SD", "low_MED", "activity_total"]
_MUST_FAIL = ["mmse_TOTAL", "TOTAL", "Q13_2", "DIAG_NM", "activity_non_wear", "cf_nonwear_mean", "n_days", "gap_days", "valid_days"]
assert not [n for n in _MUST_PASS if FORBIDDEN_PATTERN.search(n)], "가드 오탐"
assert all(FORBIDDEN_PATTERN.search(n) for n in _MUST_FAIL), "가드 미탐"
def assert_no_forbidden(names, where):
    bad = [n for n in names if FORBIDDEN_PATTERN.search(str(n))]
    if bad:
        raise RuntimeError(f"[fail-closed] {where}에 금지 컬럼: {bad}")

SRC = {
    "act_tr":   DATA_ROOT / "1.Training"   / "SourceData"   / "1.Gait" / "train_activity.csv",
    "act_va":   DATA_ROOT / "2.Validation" / "SourceData"   / "1.Gait" / "val_activity.csv",
    "slp_tr":   DATA_ROOT / "1.Training"   / "SourceData"   / "2.Sleep"/ "train_sleep.csv",
    "slp_va":   DATA_ROOT / "2.Validation" / "SourceData"   / "2.Sleep"/ "val_sleep.csv",
    "lab_tr_g": DATA_ROOT / "1.Training"   / "LabelingData" / "1.Gait" / "training_label.csv",
    "lab_tr_s": DATA_ROOT / "1.Training"   / "LabelingData" / "2.Sleep"/ "training_label.csv",
    "lab_va_g": DATA_ROOT / "2.Validation" / "LabelingData" / "1.Gait" / "val_label.csv",
    "lab_va_s": DATA_ROOT / "2.Validation" / "LabelingData" / "2.Sleep"/ "val_label.csv",
}
for k, p in SRC.items():
    if "3.CognitiveFunction" in str(p):
        raise RuntimeError("[fail-closed] MMSE 경로가 소스 목록에 있습니다.")
    if not p.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"{k}: {p}")

def _read_label(pg, ps):
    g = pd.read_csv(pg)[["SAMPLE_EMAIL", "DIAG_NM"]].copy()
    s = pd.read_csv(ps)[["SAMPLE_EMAIL", "DIAG_NM"]].copy()
    for d in (g, s):
        d["SAMPLE_EMAIL"] = d["SAMPLE_EMAIL"].astype(str).str.strip()
    g = g.sort_values("SAMPLE_EMAIL").reset_index(drop=True)
    s = s.sort_values("SAMPLE_EMAIL").reset_index(drop=True)
    if not g.equals(s):
        raise RuntimeError("Gait / Sleep 라벨 사본 불일치")
    return g
lab = pd.concat([_read_label(SRC["lab_tr_g"], SRC["lab_tr_s"]), _read_label(SRC["lab_va_g"], SRC["lab_va_s"])], ignore_index=True)
lab = lab.rename(columns={"SAMPLE_EMAIL": "sid"})
lab["y3"] = lab["DIAG_NM"].map({"CN": 0, "MCI": 1, "Dem": 2}).astype(int)
_c = lab["DIAG_NM"].value_counts().to_dict()
print(f"피험자 {len(lab)}명  CN {_c.get('CN',0)} / MCI {_c.get('MCI',0)} / Dem {_c.get('Dem',0)}")
assert len(lab) == 174 and _c.get("CN") == 111 and _c.get("MCI") == 51 and _c.get("Dem") == 12

ACT_COLS = ["EMAIL", "activity_day_start", "activity_low", "activity_medium", "activity_non_wear", "activity_total",
            "CONVERT(activity_met_1min USING utf8)"]
SLP_COLS = ["EMAIL", "sleep_bedtime_start", "sleep_bedtime_end", "sleep_duration", "sleep_total"]
act_raw = pd.concat([pd.read_csv(SRC["act_tr"], usecols=ACT_COLS, low_memory=False),
                     pd.read_csv(SRC["act_va"], usecols=ACT_COLS, low_memory=False)], ignore_index=True)
slp_raw = pd.concat([pd.read_csv(SRC["slp_tr"], usecols=SLP_COLS, low_memory=False),
                     pd.read_csv(SRC["slp_va"], usecols=SLP_COLS, low_memory=False)], ignore_index=True)
for d in (act_raw, slp_raw):
    d["sid"] = d["EMAIL"].astype(str).str.strip()
def _naive(s):
    return pd.to_datetime(s.astype(str).str.slice(0, 19), format="%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S", errors="coerce")
act_raw["ts"] = _naive(act_raw["activity_day_start"]); act_raw["date"] = act_raw["ts"].dt.date
slp_raw["ts_start"] = _naive(slp_raw["sleep_bedtime_start"])
slp_raw["ts_end"] = _naive(slp_raw["sleep_bedtime_end"]); slp_raw["date"] = slp_raw["ts_end"].dt.date
assert act_raw["ts"].notna().all() and slp_raw["ts_end"].notna().all(), "NaT timestamp"
assert (act_raw["ts"].dt.hour == 4).all(), "activity_day_start 가 04:00 이 아닙니다"

# (A) run-2/run-4 규칙 그대로: sleep 은 (sid,date) 별 최장 duration, activity 는 (sid,date) 정렬 후 keep-first
slp_a = (slp_raw.sort_values(["sid", "date", "sleep_duration"], ascending=[True, True, False])
             .drop_duplicates(["sid", "date"], keep="first").reset_index(drop=True))
act_a = (act_raw.sort_values(["sid", "date"]).drop_duplicates(["sid", "date"], keep="first").reset_index(drop=True))
daily = act_a.merge(slp_a, on=["sid", "date"], how="inner", suffixes=("", "_s"))
daily = daily[daily["sid"].isin(set(lab["sid"]))].sort_values(["sid", "date"]).reset_index(drop=True)
_n = daily.groupby("sid").size()
print(f"조인 {len(daily):,}행 / {daily['sid'].nunique()}명 / 일수 min {_n.min()} med {int(_n.median())} max {_n.max()}")
assert daily["sid"].nunique() == 174 and _n.min() >= 35 and len(daily) == 12150

# (B) CT9b: concat 순서에 의존하지 않는 명시적 tie-break 키 (sid, date, ts, activity_total desc) 로 같은 day set·값이 나오는가
_dup_act = int(act_raw.duplicated(["sid", "date"]).sum()); _dup_slp = int(slp_raw.duplicated(["sid", "date"]).sum())
act_b = (act_raw.sort_values(["sid", "date", "ts", "activity_total"], ascending=[True, True, True, False], kind="mergesort")
             .drop_duplicates(["sid", "date"], keep="first").reset_index(drop=True))
slp_b = (slp_raw.sort_values(["sid", "date", "sleep_duration", "ts_start"], ascending=[True, True, False, True], kind="mergesort")
             .drop_duplicates(["sid", "date"], keep="first").reset_index(drop=True))
daily_b = act_b.merge(slp_b, on=["sid", "date"], how="inner", suffixes=("", "_s"))
daily_b = daily_b[daily_b["sid"].isin(set(lab["sid"]))].sort_values(["sid", "date"]).reset_index(drop=True)
_same_days = (len(daily_b) == len(daily) and (daily_b[["sid", "date"]].astype(str).values == daily[["sid", "date"]].astype(str).values).all()
              and np.array_equal(daily_b["activity_low"].to_numpy(float), daily["activity_low"].to_numpy(float))
              and np.array_equal(daily_b["CONVERT(activity_met_1min USING utf8)"].to_numpy(), daily["CONVERT(activity_met_1min USING utf8)"].to_numpy()))
CT["CT9b_explicit_tiebreak_identical"] = {"gate": True, "pass": bool(_same_days), "activity_dup_rows": _dup_act, "sleep_dup_rows": _dup_slp}
print(f"CT9b 명시적 tie-break 동일성: {_same_days} (activity 중복 {_dup_act}, sleep 중복 {_dup_slp})")
assert _same_days
SIDS = sorted(lab["sid"].tolist())
lab = lab.set_index("sid").loc[SIDS].reset_index()
y3 = lab["y3"].to_numpy(int); ybin = (y3 > 0).astype(int)
source_cells.cell4_features:
# ============================================================================
# 셀 4 — D블록 특징 (run-4 cell 5 와 동일: 35일 전부, 게이트 없음) → CT1 지문·정확 일치, CT2 부분집합 비트 동일
# ============================================================================
def _fin(x):
    x = np.asarray(x, float); return x[np.isfinite(x)]
def ST_SD(x):
    x = _fin(x); return float(np.std(x, ddof=0)) if x.size >= 3 else np.nan
def ST_MED(x):
    x = _fin(x); return float(np.median(x)) if x.size else np.nan

FEATURES = ["low_SD", "low_MED"]
def build_features(w, sids):
    """피험자별 D블록 + label-free 참조 변수. 다른 피험자에 의존하지 않는다 (CT2)."""
    rows = []; sid_arr = w["sid"].to_numpy()
    for s in sids:
        g = w.iloc[np.flatnonzero(sid_arr == s)]
        _d = pd.to_datetime(g["date"])
        rows.append({"low_SD": ST_SD(g["low"]), "low_MED": ST_MED(g["low"]),
                     "cf_nonwear_mean": float(_fin(g["nonwear"]).mean()),
                     "cf_gap_days": float((_d.max() - _d.min()).days + 1 - WINDOW_DAYS),
                     "cf_ndays_window": float(len(g))})
    return pd.DataFrame(rows, index=pd.Index(sids, name="sid"))
DM = pd.DataFrame({"sid": W["sid"].to_numpy(), "date": W["date"].to_numpy(), "low": W["activity_low"].to_numpy(float),
                   "nonwear": W["activity_non_wear"].to_numpy(float)})
FEAT_ALL = build_features(DM, SIDS)
FEAT = FEAT_ALL[FEATURES]
assert_no_forbidden(FEAT.columns, "FEAT")
assert FEAT.shape == (174, 2) and FEAT.notna().all().all()
X174 = FEAT.to_numpy(float)

def fingerprint(df):
    return hashlib.sha256(np.ascontiguousarray(np.round(np.nan_to_num(df.to_numpy(float), nan=-9999.0), 9)).tobytes()
                          + "|".join(df.columns).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
FP_B0 = fingerprint(FEAT)
EXPECTED_FP = "3bc37d120081437d"          # run-4 cell 6 출력 (B0 지문)
ct1 = {"gate": True, "fingerprint": FP_B0, "expected": EXPECTED_FP, "pass": FP_B0 == EXPECTED_FP}
if REF_RUN4.exists():
    _ref = pd.read_csv(REF_RUN4).set_index("sid").loc[SIDS]
    _d1 = float(np.max(np.abs(_ref["low_SD"].to_numpy(float) - X174[:, 0]))); _d2 = float(np.max(np.abs(_ref["low_MED"].to_numpy(float) - X174[:, 1])))
    ct1.update({"max_abs_diff_low_SD_vs_run4": _d1, "max_abs_diff_low_MED_vs_run4": _d2})
    # CSV 는 텍스트 round-trip 이라 1e-14 급 차이가 난다 → 허용 1e-12. 정확성 주장은 지문(소수 9자리)과 CT3(비트 동일 nested 재현)이 담당한다.
    ct1["csv_tolerance"] = 1e-12
    ct1["pass"] = bool(ct1["pass"] and _d1 <= 1e-12 and _d2 <= 1e-12)
CT["CT1_feature_fingerprint_and_exact_match"] = ct1
print(f"CT1 지문 {FP_B0} (기대 {EXPECTED_FP}) | run-4 정확 일치: {ct1.get('max_abs_diff_low_SD_vs_run4', 'n/a')}, {ct1.get('max_abs_diff_low_MED_vs_run4', 'n/a')} → {ct1['pass']}")
assert ct1["pass"], "CT1 실패 — 특징 재구축이 run-4 와 다르다"

_rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED); _sub = sorted(_rng.choice(SIDS, size=90, replace=False).tolist())
_F = build_features(DM[DM["sid"].isin(_sub)].reset_index(drop=True), _sub)
_a = _F.to_numpy(float); _b = FEAT_ALL.loc[_sub, _F.columns].to_numpy(float)
_same = bool(((_a == _b) | (np.isnan(_a) & np.isnan(_b))).all())
CT["CT2_subject_independence"] = {"gate": True, "pass": _same, "n_subset": 90, "n_columns": int(_F.shape[1])}
print(f"CT2 90명 부분집합 재구축 비트 동일: {_same}"); assert _same

model.C_rule: frozen at B0 arm fold-modal C (93/100); inner-CV audit on 174 recorded below, never used to change C
model.score_rule: x_imp = where(isnan(x), imputer.statistics, x); z = (x_imp - scaler.mean) / scaler.scale; logits = z @ coef.T + intercept; p = softmax(logits); score = 1 - p[:, classes.index(0)]
